existing_owners.inspect: Already opens a bounded ELF via debug/elf and proves mappings; add optional unique24B ELF register-info observation here, without a new parser/function or operation flag. Invalid/missing/ambiguous metadata remains an unknown GP fact and must not break non-GP outputs.
existing_owners.normalizeReference: Reuse existing addiu_vma/reg fields for gp_relative single-instruction geometry; reject foreign data/LUI/struct coordinates.
existing_owners.referenceTarget: Enhance existing one-word interpretation for a nonzero destination register plus an internally observed GP value; require ADDIU opcode, rs28 and declared rt. Signed imm16 arithmetic wraps32bits as existing code pairs do.
existing_owners.references: Join independently mapped raw instruction words with inspect-owned register-info facts; preserve partial errors, duplicates/shared sites and ordinary target mappings. Only GP-selected reports publish GPmetadata.
existing_owners.plan: Preserve existing GP write refusals explicitly; pointer_check must not start accepting new normalized geometry. stream paths already restrict reference types.
existing_owners.tests: Extend existing CLI example/oracle loop and existing refusal/vector owners, no new testfunctions. Independent portable literals and original source/native facts frozen before candidate execution.

new_type_proposal.name: ELFRegisterInfo
new_type_proposal.purpose: Groups optional section index, exact bounded metadata bytes/global pointer or explicit error; shared inspect/reference reporting fact. A GPvalue alone would hide its source, while independent parallel fields would scatter the contract.
considered: Inspection retains combined inspection outcomes; adding optional grouped metadata is its responsibility.
ELFMapping describes VMA projection, not ELF section metadata; do not mix domains.
RegistryInput is file identity and cannot own observed register info.
ReferenceGeometry owns normalized instruction coordinates and the internally joined GP value, not ELF parsing.

trust_boundary: Read-only ELFmetadata/address-construction facts, not actual runtimeGP/register liveness/displayownership. Missing/duplicate/size/compression/bounds/shape/refusal checks stay explicit. No landing/ID fallback.
new_type_actual: ELFRegisterInfo groups section index/range, known-or-unknown GP and error; Geometry receives observedGP only after inspect proof.
